rows.name: Seed Bank Exchange
rows.description: The regional seed curator chooses between Climate Archive, sending seeds into long-term storage, and Field Release, sending them promptly to growers. The neighboring seed bank chooses between Sealed Lots, keeping samples individually contained, and Mixed Lots, combining samples for transport in the exchange.

rows.name: Seed Bank Exchange
rows.description: A regional seed bank curator chooses between Early Exchange and Delayed Exchange for a routine packet of crop seeds. A partner seed bank curator chooses between Open Terms and Strict Terms for the same exchange.

rows.name: Radio Telescope Scheduling
rows.description: A radio observatory coordinator chooses between Deep Survey and Quick Scan for an observing session. A visiting astronomer chooses between Early Slot and Late Slot for the requested radio telescope time.

rows.name: Sawmill Kiln Booking
rows.description: A sawmill manager and a kiln operator are arranging a modest lumber-drying booking. A sawmill manager chooses either Early batch or Late batch, while a kiln operator chooses either Reserved slot or Open slot.

rows.name: Rope Ferry Staffing
rows.description: A rope ferry operator and a riverside crossing coordinator jointly plan the daily service. The rope ferry operator chooses between One-person watch and Two-person watch, while the riverside crossing coordinator chooses between Morning staffing and Evening staffing.

rows.name: Shared Greenhouse Heat
rows.description: A commercial greenhouse operator with a valuable crop chooses between Share heat and Hold heat. A nearby hobby greenhouse grower, whose small plot is less exposed to a bad night, chooses between Open intake and Close intake.

rows.name: Glacier Survey Flights
rows.description: The glacier survey coordinator and the charter pilot are planning a routine survey flight. The glacier survey coordinator chooses between Dawn launch and Midday launch, while the charter pilot chooses between Direct route and Staged route.

rows.name: Neighborhood Route Bids
rows.description: A courier company and a dispatch coordinator are arranging a neighborhood delivery contract. The courier company chooses between Direct route and Detour route, while a dispatch coordinator chooses between Firm bid and Open bid.

rows.gateReason: claimFree: a claim that one player offers and the other accepts
rows.name: Herbarium Loan Request
rows.description: The grant-dependent botanist submits either a detailed request or an abbreviated request to borrow a rare specimen, with the botanist's research career heavily exposed to the decision. The herbarium curator chooses whether to approve the loan or decline the loan.

rows.name: Oyster Bed Lease
rows.description: An oyster grower and a neighboring leaseholder are arranging a modest seasonal oyster-bed lease. The oyster grower chooses Early renewal or Late renewal, while the neighboring leaseholder chooses Shared racks or Separate racks.

rows.name: Orchard Frost Watch
rows.description: An orchard owner and a county frost coordinator prepare for a cold night in the same growing district. The orchard owner chooses between “Heaters Ready” and “Heaters Idle,” while the county frost coordinator chooses between “Night Watch” and “Remote Alert.”

rows.name: Quarry Blasting Windows
rows.description: A quarry manager chooses between Dawn window and Midday window for a routine quarry blast. A haul-road coordinator chooses between Basic notice and Full notice for arranging traffic around the blasting window.

rows.name: Cheese Cave Timing
rows.description: An affineur managing a neighborhood cheese cave chooses between Early Turn and Late Turn for a batch's ripening schedule. A small dairy cooperative chooses between Standard Delivery and Flexible Delivery for sending the batch to the cave.

rows.name: Dyeing Shift Plans
rows.description: A textile mill manager chooses between Standard Batch and Rush Batch for an ordinary dyeing shift, while a dye supplier chooses between Local Dye and Blended Dye. They set their plans for the same textile order.

rows.name: Osier Bed Contract
rows.description: An osier-bed manager is choosing between Early cutting and Late cutting for the season's rods. A basket-maker is choosing between a Firm order and a Flexible order for receiving the cut osier.

rows.name: Shared Silage Clamp
rows.description: A dairy farmer and a neighboring livestock keeper share a silage clamp for routine feed storage. The dairy farmer chooses between Reserve space and Release space, while the neighboring livestock keeper chooses between Fixed booking and Flexible booking.

rows.name: Oyster Bed Lease
rows.description: A coastal oyster cooperative is deciding whether to offer a Rotational Lease or a Long Lease for a productive bed. A regional shellfish buyer is choosing between a Standing Contract and a Spot Contract for purchasing the harvest.

rows.name: Cable Ferry Crossing
rows.description: The ferry operator responsible for the day's cable crossing chooses between “Steady pull” and “Fast pull.” The local passenger making one ordinary trip chooses between “Board early” and “Board late.”

rows.name: Glacier Survey Flights
rows.description: A glacier survey coordinator plans the season's flights and chooses between High Pass and Valley Pass. A charter operator assigns aviation support and chooses between Dedicated Crew and Shared Crew for the campaign.

rows.name: Winter Apiary Siting
rows.description: A beekeeper is planning where to site hives for winter, choosing between Sheltered Grove and Windward Meadow. An orchard manager controls the surrounding land and chooses between Winter Access and Closed Access.

rows.name: Harvest Press Scheduling
rows.description: For the high-stakes harvest season, a cider cooperative must choose between an Early booking and a Late booking for its press time. Meanwhile, an orchard consortium must choose between offering a Shared slot and a Dedicated slot at the regional cider press.

rows.name: Mountain Hut Resupply
rows.description: The remote mountain-hut manager chooses between a pack-train delivery and an air drop for the hut’s critical seasonal provisions. The alpine logistics coordinator chooses whether to schedule the resupply mission in the early or late weather window.

rows.name: Seaweed Drying Schedule
rows.description: A seaweed farmer chooses between Open racks and Sheltered racks for drying a harvest. A seaweed processor chooses between Morning pickup and Evening pickup for collecting it.

rows.name: Seasonal Collections
rows.description: The university library acquisitions director chooses between Core Classics and Emerging Voices for a major seasonal collection. The academic publisher chooses between Major Release and Limited Release for the same collection.

rows.name: Kelp Harvest Contracts
rows.description: The kelp-farm manager chooses between Early harvest and Delayed harvest for the farm's crop. The coastal processing cooperative chooses between Spot contract and Reserve contract for receiving that crop.

rows.name: Orbital Downlink Scheduling
rows.description: A national satellite operator with a season-critical imaging campaign chooses between an Early Window and a Late Window for its downlink. A smaller ground-station cooperative, with much less exposure to the campaign's success, chooses between a Reserved Pass and a Shared Pass for handling that transmission. The operator and the cooperative are coordinating the same satellite downlink window.

rows.name: Library Acquisitions
rows.description: The acquisitions librarian is deciding between Local History and Popular Fiction for the library’s next small purchase. The independent publisher is deciding between Print Edition and Digital Edition as the form to offer for that acquisition.

rows.name: Reindeer Route Planning
rows.description: A reindeer herder chooses either Valley Route or Ridge Route for the seasonal migration. A neighboring grazing coordinator chooses either Early Crossing or Late Crossing to schedule access through the shared range.

rows.name: Urban Beehive Siting
rows.description: A city beekeeper coordinator is choosing between Rooftop Apiary and Park Apiary for a new urban hive cluster. An urban planning officer is choosing between Approve Site and Shift Site as the siting review proceeds.

rows.name: Seasonal Hedge Contract
rows.description: The estate manager is arranging a substantial hedge-laying contract with the rural contractor before the season begins. The estate manager chooses between Early Laying and Late Laying, while the rural contractor chooses between Full Crew and Lean Crew.

rows.name: Oyster Bed Leases
rows.description: An oyster cooperative chooses between a sheltered lease and an outer-bank lease for the coming season. A coastal authority chooses between a seasonal permit and a long permit for that bed.

rows.name: Telescope Mirror Recoating
rows.description: At a scheduled telescope mirror recoating, the observatory director chooses between Full Recoat and Spot Recoat. The coating contractor chooses between Premium Film and Quick Cure for the job.

rows.name: Seasonal Quota Negotiation
rows.description: A fishing cooperative negotiates with a regional fisheries council over the fleet's seasonal catch limit. The fishing cooperative chooses either High Quota or Conservative Quota, while the regional fisheries council chooses either Strict Cap or Flexible Cap.

rows.name: Coppice Rotation Planning
rows.description: A coppice manager chooses between Early Rotation and Extended Rotation for the coming production cycle. A biomass buyer chooses between Early Intake and Deferred Intake when planning its contracted supply.

rows.name: Charcoal Burn Scheduling
rows.description: At a regional charcoal cooperative, a charcoal cooperative manager chooses between an Early Burn and a Late Burn for the kiln schedule. A restaurant-fuel distributor chooses between a Firm Order and a Flexible Order for the season's charcoal deliveries.

rows.name: Orbital Downlink Coordination
rows.description: A mission operations director chooses between Reserved Window and Flexible Window for a satellite downlink. A ground-network coordinator chooses between Priority Slot and Shared Slot for the same downlink schedule.

rows.name: Clocktower Maintenance
rows.description: A clocktower conservator chooses between Routine overhaul and Full rebuild for the tower's seasonal maintenance plan. A municipal heritage director chooses between Night closure and Open access while coordinating the work.

rows.name: Stadium Concession Pricing
rows.description: The stadium concession director chooses either Family Pricing or Premium Pricing for the season. The visiting food vendor chooses either Bundle Menu or À-la-carte Menu for its stadium sales.

rows.name: Local History Collection
rows.description: A university library acquisitions director chooses either Print Collection, a physical acquisition, or Digital Archive, a digitized acquisition. An independent publisher's licensing manager chooses either Open License or Premium License for the same collection.

rows.name: Vineyard Watering
rows.description: At a hillside vineyard, a vineyard manager chooses between Drip Schedule and Flood Schedule for the vines. A water cooperative coordinator chooses between Early Release and Late Release for the shared irrigation channel.

rows.name: Seasonal Taproom Rollout
rows.description: A regional microbrewery staking its season's reputation on one flagship release chooses between Direct Dispatch and Distributor Contract. A neighborhood beverage distributor handling one release among many chooses between Local Rollout and Broad Rollout for carrying that beer.
actorA: a regional microbrewery staking its season's reputation on one flagship release
actorB: A neighborhood beverage distributor handling one release among many

rows.name: Rope Ferry Staffing
rows.description: A rope-ferry operator must set the crew plan for a high-stakes crossing, choosing between “Full crew” and “Lean crew.” A river authority sets the operating window for that service, choosing between “Day service” and “Night service.”

rows.name: Critical Canal Lock
rows.description: A regional water authority chooses between Early Release, opening the lock's water sequence sooner, and Water Hold, retaining the current level. A downstream shipping consortium chooses between Rush Passage, sending its fleet through the scheduled window, and Delayed Passage, holding its fleet back.

rows.name: Orchard Falconry Contract
rows.description: An estate manager and a falconry contractor are arranging a season-long falconry pest-control program for an orchard. The estate manager chooses between Open Fields and Sheltered Fields for the hunting area, while a falconry contractor chooses between Broad Patrol and Targeted Patrol.

rows.name: Seaweed Rack Allocation
rows.description: A coastal seaweed cooperative is deciding how to manage its drying racks during a high-stakes harvest: it can choose Covered Racks or Open Racks. A marine-products buyer chooses between Priority Pickup and Deferred Pickup for the same harvest.

rows.name: Orchard Harvest Contracts
rows.description: An orchard owner is choosing between Early Contract and Flexible Contract for the coming harvest, while a juice company is choosing between Firm Order and Spot Purchase. Each selects one contract term before the harvest is arranged.

rows.name: Coppice Cycle Contract
rows.description: The timberland owner, whose large estate and long-term livelihood are at stake, chooses between Short Coppice, cutting on a shorter cycle, and Extended Coppice, allowing stands to mature longer. The biomass buyer, with a smaller purchasing commitment, chooses between Firm Offtake, committing to take the harvest on schedule, and Flexible Offtake, keeping pickup timing open.

rows.name: Tentpole Release Window
rows.description: A film studio and a streaming platform each control the release timing of a high-stakes tentpole movie. The film studio chooses Early Release or Delayed Release, while the streaming platform chooses Same-Week Launch or Later Launch for its movie.

rows.name: Seaweed Rack Agreement
rows.description: The seaweed cooperative chooses between Open racks and Covered racks for a major harvest. The shoreline land trust chooses between Lease racks and Withhold racks as it decides how the racks may be used.

rows.name: Sawmill Kiln Booking
rows.description: At a sawmill whose kiln capacity could determine a season-defining contract, the sawmill operator and the major builder must coordinate their booking choices. The sawmill operator chooses between Priority booking and Open booking, while the major builder chooses between Firm order and Flexible order.

rows.name: Oyster Bed Lease
rows.description: A coastal oyster company and a regional fisheries authority are negotiating a high-stakes oyster bed lease. The coastal oyster company chooses between Long lease and Short lease, while the regional fisheries authority chooses between Renewal rights and No renewal.

rows.name: Ferry Timetable Slots
rows.description: A ferry operator is assigning its service to either the Early Slot or the Late Slot in a ferry timetable. A port authority is deciding whether to offer a Shared Dock or a Reserved Dock for that timetable.

rows.name: Oyster Bed Leases
rows.description: An oyster grower is deciding whether to use Dense planting or Sparse planting in a leased bed. A coastal lease steward is choosing between an Open lease and a Restrictive lease for that bed.

rows.name: Freight Corridor Scheduling
rows.description: A freight carrier and a rail authority are setting the operating plan for a heavily used freight corridor. The freight carrier chooses between Priority Routing and Flexible Routing, while the rail authority chooses between Strict Slots and Open Slots.

rows.name: Cheese Cave Ripening
rows.description: The cheesemaker chooses between Early Release and Deep Ripening for a batch of wheels. The cave manager chooses between Stable Humidity and Variable Humidity for the ripening room.

rows.name: Emergency Triage Coordination
rows.description: An emergency department director is choosing between Surge Team and Standard Roster for staffing a high-pressure triage shift. A regional hospital administrator is choosing between Rapid Transfer and Local Capacity for coordinating where incoming patients are handled.

rows.name: Charcoal Burn Scheduling
rows.description: A charcoal cooperative's kiln manager chooses between an Early Burn and a Delayed Burn for a season-critical production run. A regional power coordinator chooses between a Reserve Schedule and a Peak Schedule for the same charcoal-burning window.

rows.name: Mission Mirror Recoat
rows.description: A national observatory and a precision-optics contractor must decide how to handle a telescope mirror whose condition could determine a mission's success. The observatory chooses between Full Recoat and Patch Recoat, while the recoating contractor chooses between Rush Slot and Cleanroom Slot for the work.

rows.name: Truffle Grove Permits
rows.description: A truffle cooperative chooses between Open Permits, allowing broad seasonal access, and Limited Permits, restricting access to selected foragers. A regional conservation office chooses between Season Access for the regular harvest period and Reserve Access for a protected permit arrangement.

rows.name: Orchard Harvest Contract
rows.description: The orchard cooperative is choosing between Exclusive contract and Open auction for a major harvest, while the national juice company is choosing between Premium advance and Spot purchase. Their decisions set the terms for a high-stakes orchard harvest contract that could reshape both businesses.

rows.name: Championship Ice Renewal
rows.description: A national championship is approaching, and the rink operator must choose between Full Resurface and Rapid Resurface for the competition ice. The championship organizer must choose between Approve Plan and Reject Plan for the proposed resurfacing schedule.

rows.name: Wind-Farm Maintenance Scheduling
rows.description: A wind-farm maintenance coordinator chooses between Planned overhaul and Deferred repair for a turbine cluster. A grid operator chooses between Stable dispatch and Peak dispatch for the same operating period.

rows.name: Osier Bed Contract
rows.description: An osier-bed owner chooses between Early cutting and Delayed cutting for a harvest that could determine the future of the holding. A regional basketworks chooses between Firm order and Open order for the same osier supply.

rows.name: Vineyard Water Allocation
rows.description: The vineyard owner chooses between Deep watering and Rationed watering for the estate. The downstream water cooperative chooses between Early release and Late release for the shared reservoir schedule, setting the terms of a high-stakes irrigation season.

rows.name: Seed Bank Exchange
rows.description: A seed-bank curator must choose between Broad Release and Guarded Release for a vital crop line. An agricultural consortium must choose between Open Exchange and Restricted Exchange when deciding how to participate in the seed-bank exchange.

rows.name: Eel Pass Migration
rows.description: At a major river crossing, an eel-pass inspector chooses between Full inspection and Limited inspection. A dam operator chooses between Open passage and Hold passage during the migration season.

rows.name: Observatory Dome Time
rows.description: The observatory director must assign a time-critical, high-stakes observation to either the Prime window or the Reserve window. The exoplanet consortium must choose between Open access and Priority hold for that dome session.
